original_research_program: JANUS Retro-Tahyon/Principle of Janus, late-choice prospective JANUS-PHYSICAL-010

primary_mathematical_model.states: Binary earlier accessible A = hypothesized loop state L; independently set later binary C
primary_mathematical_model.assumed_noncausal_edge: Future C selects the transition kernel of the hypothesized earlier fixed-point loop
primary_mathematical_model.self_consistency: pi_C=pi_C T_C; exact stationary distribution pi_C=(v_C/(u_C+v_C),u_C/(u_C+v_C))
primary_mathematical_model.capacity_classification: Capacity of toy mathematical channel GIVEN stipulated noncausal loop; neither empirically available capacity nor Ji/Lloyd/Wilde's quantum P-CTC capacity

capacity_non_identifiability.implication: Normalization, all-outcome inclusion and consistency alone do NOT identify a physical retrocausal mechanism. Arbitrary kernels allow arbitrary near-one-bit toy capacities.
capacity_non_identifiability.additional_scientific_requirement: Derive physically measured transition dynamics independently of the desired backward-signal result, without access to future event outcomes in prior record

independent_standard_chronological_contr.equations: Early A=f(U) is irreversibly committed; later C is generated from independent source V after A. For every do(C=c), P(A=a|do(C=c))=sum_u P(U=u)1[f(u)=a], independent of c.
independent_standard_chronological_contr.nontrivial_assumption: No hidden past->future choice leakage, no backwards physical edge, no future data allowed during early A recording
independent_standard_chronological_contr.quantum_analogue: Local trace-preserving channel on the distant future subsystem preserves already accessible unconditional local marginal

scientific_conclusion.next_gate: Find source-independent, falsifiable fundamental field or dynamical equation predicting a specific transition kernel and nontrivial phenomena beyond this fit-by-assumption example; require prospective independent early custody and truly late free physical choice. Never treat ordinary CPU's offline recomputation of pi_C as earlier transmission.
